About the work from home job/internship

As a react native engineer (iOS) intern at Humanity Founders, you will have the exciting opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects that make a positive impact on society. We are looking for a talented individual who is proficient in iOS development, as well as knowledgeable in Android, Firebase, Express.js, Flutter, MongoDB, NestJS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Problem Solving, Python, React Native, Redis, Redux, REST API, Socket.IO, UI & UX Design, UX Research, and Figma.

Selected intern's day-to-day responsibilities include:

1. Collaborate with the development team to design and implement innovative mobile applications using React Native.
2. Assist in debugging and troubleshooting issues to ensure seamless user experience on iOS devices.
3. Conduct research and analysis to improve UI/UX design and enhance user engagement.
4. Utilize Firebase and other backend technologies to optimize app performance.
5. Work on REST API integration and real-time communication using Socket.IO.
6. Participate in code reviews and contribute to the overall improvement of the development process.
7. Identify and solve technical challenges to deliver high-quality solutions that align with company goals.

Join us in making a difference by revolutionizing the way technology serves humanity!

About Humanity Founders

Our ventures span from publicly launched companies to stealth-mode startups, each united by the mission to drive lasting, positive change.
